name: amwalpay-ecr-js-monorepo
description: Amwal Pay ECR SDK for JavaScript: @amwalpay/ecr-js (Node.js) and @amwalpay/ecr-react (React), with the example web till.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @amwalpay/ecr-js && npm run build -w @amwalpay/ecr-react
scripts.test: npm run test -w @amwalpay/ecr-js && npm run test -w @amwalpay/ecr-react
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @amwalpay/ecr-js && npm run typecheck -w @amwalpay/ecr-react
